lines: Buffalo is 8-1 after 31-12 at the Jets, James Cook III ran 18 for 157 and a score. The Bills are the AFC's best record.
San Francisco won 46-40 at Dallas to go 8-1. Purdy 22/28 for 389 and 3 TD, McCaffrey 4 catches for 161 and 2 TD. They host Minnesota in Mexico City, SF -3.
Jacksonville hammered Tennessee 40-23 to reach 7-2. Lawrence 352 and 3 TD. They are -6.5 at the Giants next.
Mahomes threw 5 TDs in a 35-10 win at Atlanta. KC is 7-2 and -16.5 at home against Arizona.
Minnesota took Lambeau 30-10 and sits 7-2. Green Bay drops to 6-4.
Baltimore hosts winless LA Chargers Tuesday 9:15 am Perth, BAL -4.5 with a 38.5 total. Then the Ravens are a 2.5-point dog at Carolina.

postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati won the line of the game. 484 yards on 7.4 per play against 222 and 3.8, plus 35:09 of possession. Burrow was clean, no turnovers either way, and 5-of-6 in the red zone.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 35/44, 409 yards, 4 TD, 0 INT. One sack taken for 3 yards.
Ja'Marr Chase: 11 catches, 231 yards. No scores needed, he just moved the whole field.
Chase Brown: 10 carries for 44 yards and 8 catches for 39 yards with 2 receiving TDs.
postgame.division_meaning: Bengals are 7-2 on a W5 streak with a +85 differential and sole possession of first. Pittsburgh falls to 6-3, Cleveland is 6-4 after beating Houston 27-24, Baltimore 4-5 on an L4 slide.
postgame.the_take: Rodgers threw for 143 yards and Pittsburgh went 0-for-2 in the red zone. That defensive performance is the real story here, not the 409 passing yards everyone will post about.
